That night he wrote his own note, sealed it, and let the sea take it back.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没醒。街灯照着空荡的马路，红绿灯对着无人的路口慢慢变换。早餐铺的卷帘门刚拉开一半，蒸汽从锅里冒出来。一个清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面的声音很轻。出租车停在路边，司机靠着椅背打盹。远处的楼还黑着，只有几扇窗亮着微弱的光。天边有一点点灰白，像是要亮，又还没亮。整座城安静得能听见自己的脚步。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n- Picture standing in a line of mirrors: each mirror shows a slightly smaller version of the one before it.\n- It needs a stopping point, or it would keep going forever, so there is always a simplest case where it just gives an answer."}
